scientific_claim: Across the exact two fresh immutable real-byte files and four heterogeneous motif-state degradation classes, the qualified paired-delta monitor identified the damaged motif in all eight sequential cycles with minimum positive delta and separation of 5. Every wrong same-budget repair was rejected and reverted, every correct repair exceeded the unchanged validation threshold and was retained, and independent audit returned to exact canonical predictions, probabilities, and 256-motif structure after every cycle without a live canonical shadow, tokenizer, retraining, or capacity growth.
